scope: Spent v4 English read-speech regression, not locked confirmation or a world-class claim. No fitting, threshold tuning or product changes. All stored conditions and references remain connected to their original speaker/source groups. Current quality and engineering abstention policy applied; no product perturbation-stability reruns. Candidate scores complete recordings using anchored native-size windows; no centre-only screen crop. The historical fusion uses 4-second windows; this is a source-file system comparison, not identical model inputs.

historical_baseline.scope: Stored fusion scores reused without inference. Raw comparisons use each detector frozen threshold; historical assessments retain their original policy and are not directly comparable to current candidate abstention.

score_resources.scope: Sequential synchronized MPS calls including first call. RSS includes CPU/model load; driver allocation is final resident allocation, not peak GPU memory.
